title: Xdrip disconnects  from ticwatch while I am sleeping
symptom: The user reports that their Ticwatch Pro 2020 disconnects from xDrip while sleeping, after 20-30 minutes, but does not disconnect during the day.
cause: WearOS disconnects Bluetooth when it thinks the watch goes into 'deep sleep' mode.
fix: Charge the watch overnight and have it act as main collector, as charging does not put the watch into deep sleep mode. Also, ensure 'Enable Collector' is unlocked in settings.
evidence_quote: wearOS disconnects Bluetooth when it thinks the watch goes into "deep sleep" mode. I charge my watch overnight and have it act as main collector - charging does not put the watch into deep sleep mode.
